predecessors.name: Sumerian city-states
predecessors.text: Lagash, Girsu and Nina, tributary to Uruk (En-hegal) and to Mesilim of Kish (Lugal-sha-engur) before Ur-Nanshe 'achieved independence, making himself king'

successors.name: Sumerian city-states
successors.text: Lugal-zage-si of Umma 'annexed most of the territory of Lagash under king Urukagina'; his Uruk-based kingdom is the collective's last phase

ledger.x: 2520 BCE: Ur-Nanshe makes himself king of Lagash.
2450 BCE: Lagash and Umma fall out over the Gu-edena.
2450 BCE: Umma pays tribute to Lagash after Ush's defeat and the treaty with Enakalle.
2450 BCE: Mari pays tribute to Lagash.
2425 BCE: Eannatum's hegemony lapses at his death.
2425 BCE: Umma throws off the tribute.
2425 BCE: Mari's tribute ends with Eannatum.
2425 BCE: the hold on Ur lapses at Eannatum's death (Enannatum I 'r. c.
2400 BCE: Entemena settles the Umma frontier.
2340 BCE: Lugal-zage-si of Umma conquers Lagash.

wars.name: Lagash–Umma border conflict
wars.outcome: Eannatum defeated Ush (Stele of the Vultures), made Umma tributary and fixed the boundary with Enakalle; Ur-Lumma and Il of Umma renewed the war; Entemena, with Lugal-kinishe-dudu of Uruk, subdued Il and 'reported' the conflict c.

wars.name: Eannatum's campaigns
wars.outcome: 'conquered all of Sumer', repulsed Akshak, 'defeated Kish, Akshak, and Mari', 'allegedly smote Shubur', conquered parts of Elam; Kish 'regained its independence after his death'.

wars.name: Lugal-zage-si's conquest of Lagash
wars.outcome: Urukagina defeated; Lagash's territory 'annexed' by Lugal-zage-si.

certainty.note: The Gu-edena border with Umma is the one dated line (Mesilim's arbitration, Eannatum's 'boundary treaty' with Enakalle, Entemena's report); everything else is a city territory with soft edges.
